title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: As Ye Qing departed, her whispered words hung in the air like a cold omen. Chen Ji gazed at the churning dark clouds beyond the window, and the弦 of vigilance within him tightened once more—in the secret realm, how many more chess moves lay hidden from his sight?

text.content: Ye Qing's slender fingers pinched the pitch-black Jade Pendant, its surface inscribed with ancient characters that writhed faintly in the candlelight, like the flick of a dormant serpent's tongue. Chen Ji's gaze fell upon the pendant, and deep within his pupils, the patterns of the Tianji Record flickered for an instant. Three breaths later, he withdrew his gaze, his expression unchanged. 'Your Highness the Saint Maiden honors my humble dwelling with a late-night visit. Surely you've not come merely to show me an antique, have you?' His voice was calm, even somewhat languid, as if his visitor were not the Saint Maiden of the Demonic Path, but merely an ordinary guest.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing tucked the Jade Pendant into her sleeve, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of her lips: 'Chen Gongzi certainly knows how to keep his composure.' She paced slowly toward the window, the moonlight outlining her cold, elegant profile. 'You've surely already guessed—I require your assistance.'

text.content: Chen Ji lifted the teacup from the table, gently blowing away the curling wisps of steam. He did not answer immediately; instead, he ran quick calculations in his mind. What had he seen in that brief glimpse of Heavenly Secrets? The Jade Pendant in Ye Qing's sleeve was indeed inscribed with ancient characters, but it was no ordinary storage artifact—it was the Holy Sect's 'Soul-Bound Key,' used exclusively for contracts at the soul level. And whom did she wish to bind? Him, or someone else entirely?

dialogue.content: 'Assistance?' Chen Ji set down the teacup, raising his eyes to meet Ye Qing's gaze directly. 'Your Highness commands the Holy Sect's intelligence network and holds sway over a hundred thousand believers. What possible help could you need from a Servant Disciple?' He paused, then shifted his tone. 'Or perhaps—the contract you wish to bind is not limited to just one person?'
Ye Qing's footsteps faltered for just a moment, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes. She turned around, truly regarding this Servant Disciple she had deemed 'useless': 'How did you know?'

text.content: A cold laugh stirred within Chen Ji's heart. Know? Of course he knew. In the visions the Tianji Record had shown him, Ye Qing held the Soul-Bound Key in the depths of the secret realm, signing a contract with another vague silhouette. That silhouette was obscured by the power of the Heavenly Dao; he could not see it clearly. But one thing he was certain of—it was not him, Chen Ji. She wished to bind all three of them to the same vessel, and he was merely the most insignificant stepping stone among them.

dialogue.content: 'A guess.' Chen Ji uttered the two words with studied indifference, then pivoted: 'But since Your Highness has come to find me, something must have gone wrong with that stepping stone. In the secret realm, besides this humble Chen Ji, who else could possibly catch the Saint Maiden's eye?'

Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh: 'Chen Gongzi is truly interesting.' She seated herself across from Chen Ji once more, her posture relaxing somewhat. 'Yes, there is someone within the secret realm with whom I must sign a contract. But with my strength alone, I cannot reach him. Thus—'

text.content: Chen Ji raised a hand to cut her off: 'So Your Highness requires a "key" capable of entering the secret realm's core.' He analyzed the situation at a leisurely pace. 'My identity as a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple allows me to move freely through the Outer Court without arousing suspicion. If I can open a passage for Your Highness within the secret realm, you will be able to approach that person smoothly.' He lifted his gaze, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. 'Am I right?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing applauded with a laugh: 'Chen Gongzi is truly perceptive.' Her smile carried a degree more sincerity now. 'Then, gongzi, would you be willing to make this bargain with this one?'

choice.prompt: Facing the Saint Maiden of the Demonic Path's invitation to trade, Chen Ji must decide how to respond—

choices.description: 'The trade is acceptable, but I have conditions as well. Your Highness shall conceal the aura of the Tianji Record for me within the secret realm, until I retrieve that item.'
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Demonic Path Mist's Protection, Making Actions in the Secret Realm Safer
choices.risk_hint: Exposed that he has an 'item' to retrieve, which may arouse Ye Qing's curiosity

dialogue.content: A sharp light flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, then she nodded: 'The Demonic Path Mist is but a small matter.' She drew a black Talisman Paper from her sleeve. 'This talisman can conceal your aura three times at critical moments. However—' She paused. 'What is the item you wish to retrieve?'

choices.description: 'The first three layers of the Holy Sect's 'Demon Heart Art'—I want a copy. Additionally, I require Your Highness to relay three pieces of intelligence for me within the Holy Sect.'
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Top-Tier Martial Technique Fragment Plus Intelligence Network Support
choices.risk_hint: An excessively high demand may cause Ye Qing to leave in anger

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's smile froze for an instant, then transformed into a light laugh: 'Chen Gongzi's appetite is rather large.' She did not fly into a rage; instead, a glimmer of appreciation flashed in her eyes. 'The Demon Heart Art can be given, but the number of intelligence requests must be reduced to one. What does gongzi think?'

choices.description: 'Your Highness has sought out the wrong person. This humble Chen Ji is merely a Servant Disciple; I cannot help with such matters.'
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may turn to seek other 'keys,' increasing variables

dialogue.content: Ye Qing rose to her feet, gazing down at Chen Ji: 'Chen Gongzi is certain you wish to refuse?' Her voice cooled. 'On the day the secret realm opens, the entire Tianqing Sect will enter.届时，苏青瑶……可不一定护得住你。' At that time, Su Qingyao... may not necessarily be able to protect you.

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond, merely静静地与夜清对视。烛火在两人之间摇曳，映出忽明忽暗的光影。夜清手中那枚命契之钥的存在，让他心中警铃大作。这东西一旦签订，便是灵魂层面的束缚——无论是他帮她，还是她帮他，都将被彻底绑定在一起。天机录的运转需要自由，他不能接受任何可能限制它的契约。"殿下的命契之钥，"陈机忽然开口，"能否换个方式来签订这份协议？"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze sharpened instantly: 'You know of the Soul-Bound Key?' Her eyes as she looked at Chen Ji grew dangerous. 'How does a Servant Disciple come to know of such things?'

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his teacup and took a leisurely sip. Cold sweat slid down his spine, but his expression remained utterly still. 'A guess.' he said, the exact same answer as before. 'The ancient characters inscribed on Your Highness's Jade Pendant are of the contract type. For the Saint Maiden to carry a contract artifact on her person, it must be no ordinary treasure. The Soul-Bound Key is a Holy Sect treasure—how could a humble Servant Disciple possibly truly recognize it?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing scrutinized him for a long while before finally withdrawing her gaze: 'What a clever "guess."' She seemed to accept the explanation, but a note of amusement crept into her tone. 'Since Chen Gongzi is so cautious, this one will speak plainly—no Soul-Bound Key, that can be done. But I require an alternative arrangement.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposes not using the Soul-Bound Key, but an alternative arrangement is needed. Chen Ji must decide—

choices.description: 'How about a Bloodline Oath? Using both parties' essence blood as the catalyst, we sign a temporary alliance. The contract automatically dissolves when the secret realm closes.'
choices.visible_cost: Requires consumption of 3 drops of essence blood
choices.visible_reward: Maintains a certain degree of freedom; Tianji Record's operation is unaffected
choices.risk_hint: The Bloodline Oath may have variables under the secret realm's special environment

dialogue.content: Ye Qing pondered for a moment: 'A Bloodline Oath... it is feasible. However, my bloodline differs from yours; merging them would be extremely difficult.' She raised her eyes to look at Chen Ji. 'Are you certain?'

choices.description: 'Regardless of what method is used to sign, the agreement must include one clause—neither party shall disclose the other's true purpose within the secret realm. Those who violate this shall face Heavenly Dao backlash.'
choices.visible_cost: Limits both parties' freedom of action
choices.visible_reward: The secrets of the Tianji Record become even safer
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may suspect Chen Ji is hiding something

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly let out a light laugh: 'How interesting. Chen Gongzi is so wary of this one's purpose—could it be... gongzi's purpose is even more astonishing than I imagined?'

text.content: Chen Ji met Ye Qing's searching gaze, his thoughts racing. She was already suspicious. Further concealment would only be adding insult to injury; it was better to face things openly. 'Your Highness's intelligence network spans the world,' he said calmly. 'You should know that when the secret realm opens this time, all three major sects have sent core disciples inside.' He paused. 'Though I, Chen Ji, am insignificant, if I can secure even three breaths of advantage for Your Highness within the secret realm, your plan gains one more point of certainty.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent. She had to admit, Chen Ji made sense. Within the secret realm, variables were too numerous. Even she had no full confidence in reaching that person. And Chen Ji—this Servant Disciple everyone overlooked—might actually be the best breakthrough point. 'Very well.' She finally nodded. 'Bloodline Oath, plus the confidentiality clause. This one agrees.'

A faint upward curve touched Chen Ji's lips, but he showed not a trace of smugness. He rose, walked to the window, gazing at the pitch-black night sky beyond: 'With that settled, the details still need further discussion.' He turned around. 'Your Highness's 'Demonic Path Mist'—I want five talismans. Additionally, within the secret realm, if Your Highness's actions concern my territory, you must give advance notice one day prior.'
Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: 'Five talismans is too many. Three. Advance notice of actions is acceptable, but in emergencies, this one retains the right to act on her own judgment.'

text.content: The two exchanged volley after volley, conducting a silent contest in the candlelight. In the end, the agreement was finalized: Ye Qing would provide three Demonic Path Mist Talismans; Chen Ji would be responsible for opening a passage to the core region of the secret realm for Ye Qing; both parties' actions within the secret realm would not interfere with each other, but if core interests were involved, advance consultation was required; the agreement would remain valid until the secret realm closed, at which point it would automatically dissolve. Ye Qing presented the contract covered in ancient characters before Chen Ji. 'Drip your blood.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He bit through his fingertip and let a drop of blood fall onto the contract. The blood was instantly absorbed, transforming into a faint red glow. At the same time, Ye Qing also dripped her blood. The two glows intertwined in the air, forming an invisible bond that connected the two. In that moment, Chen Ji felt a strange power surge through his bloodline—a subtle perception that allowed him to faintly sense Ye Qing's presence.

Ye Qing secured the contract and looked at Chen Ji with an entirely different gaze. This Servant Disciple was far more dangerous and far more useful than she had imagined. 'Chen Gongzi, I look forward to our cooperation.' She turned toward the window, her cloak billowing behind her like ink-dark wings.

Just as Ye Qing was about to step out the window, she suddenly halted, tilting her head to murmur: 'By the way, there is one thing this one forgot to mention to you.' Her voice was soft, yet it made Chen Ji's heart clench. 'Within the secret realm, apart from the three major sects and this one, there exists a third force. That force... is related to the Heavenly Dao.' She said nothing more, her figure already vanished into the night.

text.content: After Ye Qing's departure, Chen Ji stood by the window, gazing toward where she had disappeared, his gaze deep and heavy. Heavenly Dao's Eye. The true form of the Tianji Record, the source of the Tianji Record Fragment, and the existence he had always been secretly guarding against. How did she know? Or could it be... within the Holy Sect itself, someone had already formed ties with the 'Heavenly Dao's Eye'? Chen Ji slowly clenched his fists. The Tianji Record pulsed with gentle warmth within his Mental Sea, as if responding to his thoughts. The chess game of destiny was advancing at a speed beyond his complete control.

dialogue.content: Just then, a hoarse voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: 'Boy, your arrangement today has passed muster.' It was Mo Xiansheng. 'However—' The voice carried a deep meaning. 'You would do well to take that Saint Maiden's warning seriously. Within the secret realm, the true danger... never comes from enemies you can see.' The voice gradually faded, leaving only the final words. 'Rest well; the true trial still lies ahead.'

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated within his Mental Sea. Tonight's cooperation with Ye Qing was merely one small move in the chess game. The secret realm's opening was imminent; the three major sects, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, the Heavenly Dao's Eye... all forces churned beneath the surface, and he, Chen Ji, a Servant Disciple deemed worthless, stood at the center of this monstrous wave. He slowly opened his eyes, his gaze reflecting the churning dark clouds beyond the window. 'Come then.' he murmured. 'Let me see... who truly is the Chess Player in this game.'
